method: Real interactive CLI processes in PTYs; positional prompts, no --print or codex exec.
scope: Two synthetic text-only turns per provider in separate newly created empty temporary projects.

claude.model: Opus 5.5 (1M context), high effort; existing Claude Max login
claude.safety: --safe-mode --tools '' --permission-mode manual --strict-mcp-config with empty MCP; nonessential traffic disabled; API key environment removed

codex.model: GPT-6-Astra ultra; existing ChatGPT login required
codex.invocationOptions: --no-daemon --no-alt-screen --sandbox read-only --ask-for-approval never --disable hooks --disable plugins --disable apps --disable memories --disable shell_tool --disable unified_exec --disable shell_snapshot --disable skill_mcp_dependency_install -c 'mcp_servers.node_repl.enabled=false' -c 'mcp_servers.railway.enabled=false' -c 'mcp_servers.computer-use.enabled=false' -c 'web_search="disabled"' -c 'memories.use_memories=false' -c 'analytics.enabled=false' -c 'notify=[]' -c 'project_doc_max_bytes=0' -c 'forced_login_method="chatgpt"'

preservation: CLI-owned test histories and empty project folders retained. Inspected only transcripts with these newly created IDs.
limitations: Not a Sigil GUI or physical-phone acceptance test.
No authenticated provider tool, approval, filesystem, or error-recovery behavior tested.
No account changes, credential copies, API purchases, source edits, push, or deployment.
